They kept me updated on the progress, addressed any concerns I had, and provided a sense of security knowing that everything was being taken care of. Even after the pool school and maintenance were completed, RiverMist remained in touch to ensure that I was satisfied with the final result.

In short, RiverMist Pools and Spas, delivered an exceptional experience from start to finish. Their team of experts worked tirelessly to bring my dream pool to life, and I couldn't be happier with the result. If you're considering investing in a new pool, look no further than RiverMist Pools and Spas. They will exceed your expectations and provide you with a truly unforgettable experience.

reviews.text:
Very disappointed in the customer service. This situation dates back to 2021. As we were building a new home we were planning to build a pool. My husband & I were very indecisive..like seriously indecisive. When we finally came to a definite YES of building (months later), we returned to the office ready to sign a contract. However, by then the price had increased by about $13k-15k. Which is expected due to the pandemic. We once again backed out..not because we weren't ready but the new price was not in the budget at that time.
Here were are today May 2022...new house is finished & fully furnished so we are back to wanting a pool. My husband called Rivermist to inquire on new pricing...no return call. When he told me that he felt like this company had "black balled" him because his phone call was never returned, I disagreed. My thought was...they are just really busy. Well long story short...WE WERE BLACK BALLED by this company. I called as well. When I mentioned my name, the receptionist recognized my last name & said ohh yea, Landon has been speaking to your husband. I replied yes. I left a very detailed & long message with this Lady. I made sure to tell her that we had been indecisive in the past but we are sure today. I even told her that we already have funding & are truly ready to discuss new prices & a possible contract, if the price is right. Dayssss have passed & no return call to myself or my husband.
Indecisiveness does not equate to being DISMISSED!
A simple, professional & mature return call to inform us that you no longer want to do business with us would have sufficed. We would have simply respected your decision & found a new pool builder....as we have.

Choosing RiverMist turned out to be one of the best decisions I’ve made for my home. I came to them with a rough concept and a lot of uncertainty, and they helped shape that idea into a final design that fits my space perfectly.
What impressed me most was how genuine the process felt. There was no pushy sales pitch or inflated “dream build” meant to drive up the price. Instead, the focus was on understanding what I actually wanted and offering thoughtful recommendations that made sense for me, not their bottom line.
Throughout construction, communication was reliable and straightforward. I always knew what stage the project was in, and the crews were professional, respectful, and detail-oriented. Any questions I had were addressed quickly, which made the entire experience far less stressful than I expected.
Building a pool is a major investment, and it’s something I debated for years before committing. Now that it’s finished, I can honestly say RiverMist made the decision feel completely worthwhile. The quality of the work is evident, and the end result has already become a highlight of my home.
I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend RiverMist to anyone considering a pool.
